cost_scope: All first-pass detection/answer calls plus every conditional second pass. Input and output tokens reported separately. No money conversion or equal-total-cost superiority claim.
ambiguity_policy: All 63 traffic requests incur costs, but ICS:B2 is excluded from correctness scoring (62 scored).
latency_caveat: Summed historical request service times, not a new end-to-end latency measurement; provider cache behavior may differ on rerun.
legacy_retry_limitation: V7 saved successful responses, not all retry attempts. Counts cover recorded logical calls; retry charges cannot be fully audited from these logs.
extra_call_convention: Detector doubles as first answer. A separate classifier would add a classifier call for EVERY request plus answering calls; not equivalent to this baseline.
